name: Tamsin Reed
title: Captain of the Lanternguard
blurb: Solenne's toughest soldier, always the last one through the gate. She dragged the blind Queen clear on the Night of Falling Stars, and reads Fennick's notes to the Spirewright since he died.

name: Brannoc Emberhand
title: Smith-Lord of the Reach
blurb: The giant smith who forged Solenne's gates. Ashwick, the boy who once swept his forge, kept him chained in it for nine days to make him forge chains for the horde, and he refused every day. His hammer never cools.

name: Kaela Stormrider
title: Marshal of the Steppe
blurb: War-leader of the Galeborn, who fought the mad storm's army alone for eleven days. Lightning lance, and a grey stallion called Thunderclap. The Herald Vholt was her teacher, and she killed him facing him.

name: Sylvaine Thornwhisper
title: Bow of the Deep
blurb: The Deepwood's best archer, three hundred years old. She held Elderhollow's root-doors alone until every child was out, and carries the last seed of the oldest tree.

name: Mirelle the Tide-Seer
title: Seer of Frostmere
blurb: A blind young seer who reads the future in ice. She kept forty children alive inside a tower of ice. She has seen a death at the end of the war, and will not say whose.

name: Gorrim Stonebeard
title: Shield of the Canyon
blurb: A Stoneborn shieldmaster with an iron ring in his beard for every friend he has buried. He held the Kharum Pass beside Gorrath, and buried him too. His shield is a carved stone door.

name: Corvin the Uncrowned
title: Ranger of the Rift
blurb: The Queen's half-brother. He accused Cassivane of treason, was framed for murder and exiled, and spent six years watching the Black Gate from the edge of the Rift.

name: Ignar
title: the Cinder Warden
blurb: The Warden of Fire, one of the six monarchs who sleep to hold the Black Gate shut. Driven mad as the Cinder Tyrant, freed under Pyrrhenhall. Black stone and a molten heart.

name: Aurath
title: of the Storms
blurb: The Warden of Storm, freed from the Thunderhead over Aurvanis. A rider of cloud and lightning who is never quite still.

name: Elowen
title: the Evergreen
blurb: The Warden of Nature, cut out of the Elder Broodmother at Sylvanmere. Very old, very tired, and still growing.

name: Thalassa
title: of the Deep
blurb: The Warden of Water, freed from the Tidal Leviathan under Pearlhaven. She gave away her forgetting, so she remembers everything, including what the six did at Vael.

name: Orrok
title: the Mountain
blurb: The Warden of Earth, freed from the Mountain Titan under Grundhallow. A slow stone giant with trees on his shoulders, who had not spoken in two thousand years.

name: Nyxara
title: of the Hollow
blurb: The Warden of Void, who fought the Hollow King's crown from the inside at Umbrael. She can hear what walks under her land.

name: Ilyra the Unbroken
title: Daughter of the Regent
blurb: Cassivane's daughter. Six years ago she slipped into the Black Gate and was caught; she came back empty, and found herself again on her own once she was free of her father's cage.

name: Seraphel the Dawnblade
title: Knight of the Sunstone
blurb: The last knight of the Sunstone, kept alive by its light for a thousand years. Since it broke she has been dying, and she has one fight left.

name: Oswin the White Lantern
title: Master of the Order of the Spire
blurb: Pushed the Black Gate back to a cart-wide gap at the start of the war and fell through it. He walked back under the world, found the last piece of the Sunstone at the bottom of the Rift, and relit it.

name: Queen Ysolde
title: Queen of Solenne, the narrator
blurb: Ruler of the Concord. Blinded on the Night of Falling Stars while she ran with the Heartstone; she rules by voice and tells the story.

name: Master Tobias Fennick
title: Chief Tower-Wright
blurb: The gruff old engineer who designed every tower and briefs the Spirewright. He died holding Solenne's east gate on the Night of Falling Stars.

name: Cassivane Dral
title: the Ashen Regent
blurb: Lord Marshal of the Concord. He cut a sliver off the Heartstone and unlocked the Black Gate, because Vael-Orrun promised to give back his daughter.

name: Saltmother Ourra
title: the Drowned Herald
blurb: Once the Tidefolk's high priestess, sent to the Rift under Cassivane's seal and sent back empty to drown her own people. Walks inside a column of black seawater. Boss of Reedhaven.

name: Gorrath the Quarried
title: the Stone Herald
blurb: A Stoneborn general who held the Kharum Pass for a month, sent back from the Rift with a stone for a heart, then sent home to turn the canyon on the Stoneborn. Breaks into walking boulders. Boss of the Kharum Terraces.

name: The Pale Vesper
title: the Hollow Herald
blurb: A Veilwalker singer who sang at funerals, and now sings her own people's dead awake. Boss of Vesperhold.

name: Ashwick the Kindled
title: the Flame Herald
blurb: Born in Kethra, he swept Brannoc's forge, then became the Concord's youngest messenger and ran to the Rift. An ever-burning boy who never stops running. Boss of Brazier Hold.

name: Vholt Stormcrown
title: the Sky Herald
blurb: The Galeborn warchief who taught Kaela to ride, riding a thunderbird of black cloud. Boss of Highwind.

name: Mother Briar
title: the Thorn Herald
blurb: The Deepwood's wisest healer, grown through with thorns. Dying, she names the Marshal. Boss of Elderhollow.
Revealed only in the post-credits scene. The villain of Part 2. Keep hidden from every codex and menu.

name: Vael-Orrun
title: the High King
blurb: King of Orrun, the middle kingdom, two thousand years ago. The songs call him a tyrant, beaten and shut behind the Black Gate. He wants his crown back: the Heartstone, the key to his prison.
